item.title: Opinion: Person-centred approach to smoking cessation needed
item.description: Nicotine pouches have gained popularity internationally and are here to stay. No level of restriction will cause them to cease to exist. Canadians face two clear policy choices.

item.title: Opinion: First Ministers meeting involving Indigenous leaders 'pivotal'
item.description: Bringing provincial and federal leaders together with Indigenous leaders can be a pivotal step in charting the path forward. It can be historic, if the will is there.

item.title: Weekend roundup: Huskie women's bball squad upset in Canada West playoffs, but may not be done yet
item.description: The Huskie women's basketball is hoping for good news after an upset weekend loss to Calgary.

item.title: SHA says metal detectors installed at three more health care facilities in Sask.
item.description: Battleford Union Hospital, Prince Albert Hospital, and the Regina Urgent Care Centre will have metal detectors in effect as of Monday.

item.title: Cree educator subject of new documentary set for world premiere
item.description: In 1968, when she was 36, Freda Ahenakew attended high school at the same time as many of her 12 kids. She went on to earn several degrees.

item.title: Saskatoon groups work to reframe debate around freeway and urban sprawl
item.description: The freeway — a four-lane, 55-km stretch of divided highway connecting Highways 11 and 7 — was estimated at around $2 billion back in 2014.

item.title: Delhi Guyz brings street foods of India to the streets of Saskatoon
item.description: "We want to get the great taste of Delhi out there. I have been dreaming about getting the great flavours of India out here."

item.title: Charges laid against Saskatoon business for unlawful sale of bear spray
item.description: The charges are the first of its kind after city bylaws were recently amended.

item.title: Sask Jazz Fest announces Modest Mouse as first headliner for July festival
item.description: In a media release on Tuesday, the festival announced that Modest Mouse will be headlining on July 7, one of the ticketed dates.

item.title: Premier Scott Moe on trade, tariffs, and a post-Trump America
item.description: Moe told an NSBA luncheon on Tuesday that Canadians need to realize America "will likely be our largest trading partner post-President Trump."
